subject.title: feat(hooks): add waitForResult mode to POST /hooks/agent endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw support synchronous result return on `POST /hooks/agent` using this `waitForResult` and `announceToMain` contract, including returning agent output/errors over the existing hook-token boundary?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but the permanent API shape and output/error disclosure policy affect a public gateway security boundary and cannot be safely chosen by automation.

options.title: Adopt current shape after hardening
options.body: Accept `waitForResult`/`announceToMain` on the existing endpoint, require latest-head proof, and settle output size/redaction/error/replay semantics before merge.

options.title: Reshape the sync contract
options.body: Ask for a dedicated sync endpoint or result-token fetch flow if maintainers want a sharper boundary than extending the existing hook endpoint.

options.title: Decline core sync hooks
options.body: Keep `/hooks/agent` async-only and ask downstream systems to keep using polling or private integrations if this output path is not acceptable in core.

recommendation.title: Adopt current shape after hardening
recommendation.body: Accept `waitForResult`/`announceToMain` on the existing endpoint, require latest-head proof, and settle output size/redaction/error/replay semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the strongest recent ownership signal for the gateway hook/server files, and the decision is an API/security boundary choice.
